attempts.surface: Unified task composer attachment rail UI via Electron CDP + Playwright

actual_preconditions.fixture: 8 tiny round-owned TXT files count-01.txt through count-08.txt

attempts.input: Attached 8 round-owned files to an unsent task draft; used the visible attachment-rail scroll controls.
actual_steps: Added count-01.txt through count-08.txt in one in-app HTML file-input operation.
Observed the rail client width 135px and scroll width 1990px, with 8 file cards and individual removal controls; the right-scroll control was present.
Clicked the UI right-scroll control until the rail reached scrollLeft 1855.4 (max 1855); read back all 8 file cards and controls, including count-08.txt.
Clicked the left-scroll control 10 times and observed scrollLeft return toward the start to 198.3; initial state at scrollLeft 0 was preserved in separate evidence.
Removed all 8 attachments individually and verified the draft returned to zero attachment cards.
attempts.wait_condition: Waited after each scroll for rail state to update; verified first, final and intermediate scroll offsets and the same 8 DOM card entries.

checkpoints.observed: The attachment rail overflowed horizontally; the UI right-scroll control moved it to the end (scrollLeft 1855.4 of max 1855), and the first/last positions were captured. Left-scroll controls also moved the rail toward the start.
The UI DOM consistently exposed 8 cards with the expected filenames and 8 individual remove controls at the final scroll position; no supplied item was silently dropped.

attempts.observed_result: With eight harmless files, the attachment strip overflowed horizontally and the UI controls scrolled it through the full range. All eight items remained in the attachment rail and the unsent draft was cleaned afterward.
attempts.notes: Round-owned files only; no message sent. The intermediate return-left capture is at 198.3px, not the beginning; initial zero and max positions are separately evidenced. Pending bilateral review.

changes: Removed all 8 round-owned attachment references from the unsent draft.
remaining: Source fixtures remain under the task fixture folder.

product_observations.statement: Eight round-owned attachments exceeded the rail width; UI scroll controls moved scrollLeft from 0 to 1855.4 of max 1855 and back toward the beginning. All eight expected file cards and individual removal controls were still exposed.
product_observations.verified_depth: Actual attachment rail horizontal overflow, UI scroll buttons, full-range positions, card list and cleanup
product_observations.scope_and_limits: Eight harmless text files in an unsent round-owned draft; no message sent and no existing user asset changed.

changes: Removed all 8 round-owned attachment references from the unsent draft.
remaining: Source fixtures remain under the task fixture folder.
